source: Authenticated GitHub accessible repository inventory for owner thebrazenbeard, discovered through P.O.R.T.A.L.

inventory_digests.algorithm: SHA-256 over lexicographically sorted repository names, UTF-8, one name per line with trailing newline

privacy_rule: Private repository names are intentionally not published by this public repository. Private repositories still participate in aggregate counts and digest commitments.
archived_rule: Five archived repositories are present on this cut: two public repositories are named in archived_repositories_public and three are private and remain unnamed. Archived repositories are included in total/visibility counts and name digests and excluded from active counts.
relationship_to_v1: PORTFOLIO_CENSUS_V1 remains historical evidence for the earlier public-observatory cut and its coupled validator/graph/intake artifacts. V2 records the current repository inventory without pretending those older exact-head observatory artifacts have already been regenerated.
